description: Sends Claude Code activity (prompts, tool use, turn ends) to the local Harness Monitor, using its per-run token. Does nothing when the monitor is not running.

hooks.command: T="${HARNESS_MONITOR_HOME:-$HOME/.harness-monitor}/token"; [ -r "$T" ] && curl -s -m 2 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Agent: claude-code' -H "X-Monitor-Token: $(cat "$T")" --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:4849/api/hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
